An '''electron''' was a coherent particle that could be focused with large [[magnetic ring]]s. They were presumably used in [[electron torpedo]]es and [[Laser gate/Legends|laser gates]].

They rotated around atomic nuclei in "shells" of probability, which could shift instantaneously without passing through the intervening space.
